title: Before CDID
description: The creator's personal account 'pengemudiindo' publishes Indonesian driving places such as City of Snow Shoreside (April 2020) and Bolivia Death Road ('the next Indonesian Death Road', June 2020). It also runs GrandMini Games Studio, a group that calls itself the 'Car Driving Indonesia Official Group'. A place named 'old cdid' follows in November 2020.

title: Classic CDID
description: The first numbered builds: V1, V2.5, the Village Edition (V3.3), V3.5 and V4. V4 brought new cars and trucks, a reworked map and Jakarta, a new UI, police jobs and a new highway. Exact release dates were never published.

title: The old places come down
description: Roblox records show the original group's places last updated on 17 May 2021; all are now deleted. The reason was never published.

title: CDID is back
description: The current experience opens under the verified CDID Studio Official Group. The group is owned by Pengemudiindonesiaa (display name 'Pengemudiindo'), whom the community wiki credits as the creator. The first game passes are created the same day, and version numbers start again from V0.x.

title: Classic builds preserved
description: CDID developer Hariaall republishes V2.5 and V3.5 as archive places alongside the Village Edition, so the classic era stays playable.

title: Into Central Java
description: The Jawa Tengah map (phase 1) arrives with 114 new vehicles, a new main menu, the car modification system and the Rare Imports pass, created 28 June 2022.

title: HUT RI 78
description: Added 30 new cars and 3 special cars, an event for Indonesia's 78th Independence Day, and new modification options for lights, horn and reset.

title: Modification arrives
description: Added 102 new and reworked cars, a Halloween event and a new modification feature.

title: Version 2 and the Bali map
description: Added the Bali map, a private-server panel, a redesigned modification and speedometer UI, 76 new and reworked cars, and a Ramadhan quest.

title: Jawa Timur unlocked
description: Opened East Java (Ngawi, Kediri, Surabaya, Sidoarjo, Malang). Also introduced the Weekly Car Drop, a new mobile UI and a reworked minimap.

title: Exclusive cars
description: Introduced Exclusive cars, sold in limited unit counts, plus tyre modification, automatic headlamps and self-cancelling turn signals.

title: Phone and toll systems rebuilt
description: The Christmas update reworked the in-game phone and toll systems and added a limited-time map.

title: The seasonal-map era
description: Ramadhan 2026, Eid al-Adha 2026 and V5 Nostalgia 2026 brought seasonal maps and points-based reward cars, alongside more advanced AI traffic.

title: Bandung rebuilt
description: Bandung became a reworked standalone map, launched with a myBCA event and an Independence Day celebration.

title: Bali Phase 1 & the Gacha System
description: The current version: 92 new and reworked cars, Halloween 2026, a reworked Office Job, the Bali Phase 1 refresh and a new gacha system.

title: Over 555 million visits
description: CDID has passed 555 million visits and 436,000 favourites. The developer group has 453,000 members and the official Discord about 330,000.
